# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want ChenLink to be a welcoming project for everyone. Contributors and maintainers must communicate respectfully and focus criticism on ideas and code, not people.

## Expected behavior

- Be constructive and patient.
- Respect different experience levels and backgrounds.
- Accept feedback and correct mistakes.
- Keep issues and pull requests relevant to the project.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, threats, insults, or discriminatory language.
- Publishing private information without permission.
- Deliberately disruptive or bad-faith participation.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, close, or remove contributions that violate this code and may temporarily or permanently block repeat offenders.

## Reporting

Report conduct problems privately to the maintainer through the repository security contact.
